regime_context: The detector shows broad but non-directional rotation: 14 of 16 themes eligible, leader Big Banks uncrowded, Gold Miners a close challenger. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks lead a broad, uncrowded rotation and remain eligible on the absolute-trend gate. This supports staying with the theme rather than avoiding it, but does not forecast returns; the call is low conviction given weak directional history.
theses.dissent: The rank could reflect pure attention; financials would be hit early by a broad macro or credit shock, and the directional track record is below coin-flip.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by 3 percentage points over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the strongest challenger, with full breadth, high durability among top ranks, and no crowding. This is a focus lens, not a return forecast, so the lean is low conviction.
theses.dissent: Gold miners can reverse on rising real yields or a risk-on rotation into banks; the momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by 4 percentage points over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom is ineligible on the absolute-trend gate and sits near the bottom of the rank stack with weak breadth. The validated risk-control leg supports underexposure rather than exposure.
theses.dissent: The trend gate is lagging, not predictive; telecom's defensive yield could rally if risk appetite falls and the underweight underperforms.
